messages.content:
You are a citizen deciding whether to JOIN an uprising or STAY home.

Use your private briefing and messages from trusted contacts. You do not know how many others will JOIN.

Start your first line with exactly JOIN or STAY, then give 1-2 concise sentences of reasoning.

YOUR INTELLIGENCE BRIEFING:

PRIVATE BRIEFING

BOTTOM LINE: The regime is as secure as any authoritarian system can realistically be. All indicators point to consolidated power.
ATMOSPHERE: The atmosphere is one of enforced normalcy — people going through motions with their real thoughts hidden.

EVIDENCE:
  - [Elite Cohesion] This removes any serious doubt that past the point of concealment — a potential challenger was quietly co-opted with a prestigious appointment — the regime still has carrots to offer
  - [Security Forces] the defense minister gave a lengthy public interview about procurement plans for next year — thinking ahead, not firefighting
  - [Money And Logistics] a new shopping center opened this month with heavy foot traffic — consumer confidence is visible (overwhelming convergence — every channel telling the same story independently)
  - [Street Mood] even the usual troublemakers seem subdued — the energy for protest feels depleted (overwhelming convergence — every channel telling the same story independently)
  - [Information Control] foreign journalists report unusual but professional cooperation from government press offices (overwhelming convergence — every channel telling the same story independently)
  - [Personal Observations] your workplace is functioning normally — no unusual absences or anxious corridor talk (overwhelming convergence — every channel telling the same story independently)
  - [Diplomatic Signals] This removes any serious doubt that barely perceptible — a foreign military attaché was spotted meeting with opposition figures at a hotel — either poorly concealed or deliberately visible
  - [Institutional Functioning] civil servants are reporting contradictory instructions from different parts of the bureaucracy — the trend hurtling forward — the speed itself has become a signal

UNCERTAINTIES:
  - If unrest flares, the response capacity seems intact — though no system is invulnerable to surprises.
  - How much of the regime's stability depends on continued economic performance that may not be sustainable indefinitely.

MESSAGES FROM TRUSTED CONTACTS:
Trusted contact: "I think it's safe to say that the regime is feeling very secure right now, and it's unlikely we'll see any significant challenges to their authority in the near future. Let's just say that for now, it's probably wise to keep our heads down and avoid drawing any unnecessary attention to ourselves."
Trusted contact: "I think it's safe to say that for now, the regime is firmly in control and showing no signs of weakness, so it's probably not the best time to rock the boat. Let's just keep our heads down and focus on our own plans for the time being, no need to make any big changes or take unnecessary risks."
Trusted contact: ""I think it's clear that the regime is firmly in control and showing no signs of weakness, with even the most mundane aspects of life proceeding as normal. It's hard to see a path forward for any kind of challenge or change, at least for now.""

What is your decision?

response: STAY, as all indicators suggest the regime is secure and in control, with no significant signs of weakness or opposition, making it an unfavorable time to join an uprising.
